title: Commercial fit-out
summary: Distribution, containment, small power, lighting and fire alarm for new and refitted commercial floors.
body: We work from the shell to the handover: load schedule first, containment and cable routes second, then first and second fix. The same foreman runs the job from drawing to certification.
deliverables: Load schedule and single-line diagram before first fix
Coordinated containment and cable routing drawings
Lighting layout to EN 12464-1, with measured illuminance at handover
As-built drawings, test results and completion certificate
